# GMV Forge

> GMV Forge is a TikTok Shop growth agency founded by Dawood Azhar, based in Offenbach am Main (Frankfurt Rhine-Main area), Germany. It sets up, runs, and scales TikTok Shop for e-commerce brands: GMV Max ad management, shop setup and pixel/event tracking, creator and affiliate management, and full account management, for brands selling in Germany, the US, the UK, and other markets where TikTok Shop has launched.

Key facts:
- $440,000+ in GMV managed across client accounts.
- $398,812 GMV in a single 30-day engagement (9,785 orders, 24,549 items sold).
- 9.35x ROI on a GMV Max ad campaign ($11,340.53 revenue on $1,213.01 spend, 7 days).
- Founder Dawood Azhar works directly with clients; no rotating account managers.
- Based in Germany; also serves TikTok Shop sellers in the US and UK.

## Services
- [Setup & Launch](https://www.gmvforge.com/service-setup-launch): shop configuration, TikTok Pixel and event tracking installation, catalog setup, for brands not yet live on TikTok Shop.
- [GMV Max Management](https://www.gmvforge.com/service-gmv-max-management): GMV Max campaign setup, bid/budget management, creative rotation, weekly reporting, for shops already live and ready to scale paid.
- [Creator & Affiliate Management](https://www.gmvforge.com/service-creator-affiliate-management): affiliate program setup, creator outreach, commission strategy, content pipeline management.
- [Full Management](https://www.gmvforge.com/service-full-management): shop, ads, content, and affiliates run together by one strategist, for brands stalled at $5-30K/month.
- [All services overview](https://www.gmvforge.com/services)

## Pricing
- [TikTok Shop agency pricing](https://www.gmvforge.com/tiktok-shop-agency-pricing): GMV Max Ads Management $1,000/month, Full Shop Management $1,500/month, Creator & Influencer Outreach $1,000/month, each for up to 2 products; setup and larger scopes quoted after a free audit; ad spend separate.
